basics.name: Chandra Prakash
basics.summary: MSc Physics graduate from IIT Guwahati studying quantum fields in nontrivial gravitational backgrounds, from cosmological spacetimes to black-hole geometries. Particularly interested in Quantum Field Theory in Curved Spacetime, EFT of Gravity, Asymptotic Symmetries & Holography, and Early Universe Cosmology.

work.position: Research Collaborator - Dirac Bracket and QFT in Curved Spacetime
work.summary: Collaborator: Dr. Rajesh Karmakar. Research focus: quantum field theory in curved spacetime, black hole backgrounds, vacuum structure.
highlights: Analytical study of field dynamics in curved spacetime
Constrained systems analysis using Dirac-type methods

work.position: Non-relativistic Limit of AdS/CFT in Momentum Space
work.summary: Guide: Dr. Nirmalya Kajuri. Studied the Galilean Conformal Algebra in momentum space to deduce constraints on relativistic AdS/CFT limits.
highlights: Analyzed the Galilean Conformal Algebra (GCA) via Wigner-Inönü contraction
Derived generators in position and momentum space
Deduced and solved Ward identities for two- and three-point functions

work.summary: Guide: Prof. Dr. Debaprasad Maity. Cosmological collider physics and early-universe particle production.
highlights: Evolved cosmological correlators from the end of inflation to the CMB sky
Studied particle production and CMB effects
